sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers_on_promo_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`promotional_rate_flag` = TRUE

SELECT
  `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` AS `tier`,
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(`subscription`.`termination_date`, `subscription`.`activation_date`)), 1) AS `average_days_on_last_plan_before_cancellation`,
  COUNT(*) AS `cancelled_subscriptions`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`termination_date` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `subscription_plan`.`service_tier`
ORDER BY `average_days_on_last_plan_before_cancellation` DESC

WITH `failed_payment_accounts` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT `invoice`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` AS `payment`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `invoice`
    ON `payment`.`invoice_id` = `invoice`.`invoice_id`
  WHERE `payment`.`payment_status` = 'Failed'
    AND `invoice`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS `total_cancellations`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `failed_payment_accounts`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `cancellations_with_failed_payment_history`,
  try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `failed_payment_accounts`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0,COUNT(*)) AS `share_with_failed_payment_history`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
LEFT JOIN `failed_payment_accounts`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `failed_payment_accounts`.`subscriber_id`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `annual_paying_subs_up_for_renewal_next_60_days`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`subscription_type` = 'Annual'
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-11' AND date_add(DATE'2026-11-11', 60)

SELECT
  CASE WHEN `video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K' ELSE 'Rest' END AS `resolution_group`,
  try_divide(100.0 * SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),SUM(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`)) OVER ()) AS `viewing_percent`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `video_resolution` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CASE WHEN `video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K' ELSE 'Rest' END
ORDER BY `viewing_percent` DESC

SELECT 'Film' AS `content_category`, try_divide(AVG(`runtime_seconds`),60.0) AS `avg_runtime_minutes`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title`
WHERE `content_type` = 'Film'
  AND `runtime_seconds` IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Regular series episode' AS `content_category`, try_divide(AVG(`runtime_seconds`),60.0) AS `avg_runtime_minutes`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode`
WHERE `episode_type` = 'Episode'
  AND `runtime_seconds` IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN `series_status` = 'Ongoing' THEN 'Ongoing' WHEN `series_status` = 'Completed' THEN 'Finished' END AS `show_status`, AVG(`total_season_count`) AS `average_seasons` FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` WHERE `series_status` IS NOT NULL AND `total_season_count` IS NOT NULL AND `series_status` IN ('Ongoing', 'Completed') GROUP BY CASE WHEN `series_status` = 'Ongoing' THEN 'Ongoing' WHEN `series_status` = 'Completed' THEN 'Finished' END ORDER BY `show_status`

WITH subtitle_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `subtitle_language`,
    COUNT(`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `subtitle_language`
), ranked_subtitles AS (
  SELECT
    `subtitle_language`,
    `sessions`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `sessions` DESC) AS `rnk`
  FROM subtitle_counts
)
SELECT
  `subtitle_language`,
  `sessions`
FROM ranked_subtitles
WHERE `rnk` <= 1
ORDER BY `sessions` DESC, `subtitle_language`

SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS past_end, SUM(CASE WHEN start_date > CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_started FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign WHERE campaign_status = 'Live' GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY campaign_type LIMIT 1001

SELECT c.campaign_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.campaign_id) AS n, MAX(c.end_date) AS max_end, MAX(o.flight_end_date) AS max_flight_end, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.flight_end_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND o.flight_start_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN c.campaign_id END) AS in_flight FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order AS o ON o.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.campaign_status = 'Live' GROUP BY c.campaign_type LIMIT 1001

SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_contracted_value) AS gross_value, SUM(net_order_value) AS net_value FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY gross_value DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT 'strategic_tier' AS tier_type, p.strategic_tier AS tier, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(d.deal_value_amount) AS total_value, d.currency_code FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON d.partner_id = p.partner_id GROUP BY p.strategic_tier, d.currency_code UNION ALL SELECT 'risk_tier', p.risk_tier, COUNT(*), SUM(d.deal_value_amount), d.currency_code FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON d.partner_id = p.partner_id GROUP BY p.risk_tier, d.currency_code ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 1001

SELECT p.partner_type, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_expiration_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_but_past_expiry, SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_effective_date > CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_started FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON p.partner_id = d.partner_id WHERE d.exclusivity_flag = TRUE AND d.deal_status = 'Active' GROUP BY p.partner_type ORDER BY deals DESC LIMIT 1001

WITH c AS (SELECT ce.churn_event_id, ce.subscriber_id, ce.last_viewed_title_id, s.territory_id, CASE WHEN ce.last_viewed_title_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_title, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = s.territory_id AND w.active_flag) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_live, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = s.territory_id AND w.active_flag AND NOT w.blackout_flag) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_live_nb FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.churn_event AS ce JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = ce.subscriber_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id) AS subs, SUM(no_title) AS no_title, SUM(1 - has_live) AS no_live_events, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_live = 0 THEN subscriber_id END) AS no_live_subs, SUM(CASE WHEN no_title = 0 AND has_live = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_live_with_title, SUM(1 - has_live_nb) AS no_live_nb_events FROM c LIMIT 1001

WITH cur AS (SELECT s.subscriber_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(CASE WHEN p.plan_type = 'Paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS p USING (subscription_plan_id) WHERE s.subscription_status = 'Active' GROUP BY s.subscriber_id) SELECT c.paid, COUNT(*) AS impressions, MAX(c.n) AS maxactive FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps ON ps.playback_session_id = i.playback_session_id LEFT JOIN cur AS c ON c.subscriber_id = ps.subscriber_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.paid LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.content_type, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(i.cpm_realized) / 1000 AS ad_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT t.title_id) AS titles FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON i.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title AS t ON e.title_id = t.title_id GROUP BY t.content_type ORDER BY ad_revenue DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.territory_group AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS distinct_viewers, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps ON i.playback_session_id = ps.playback_session_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON ps.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON s.territory_id = t.territory_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.territory_group ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS total_distinct, MIN(i.delivery_date) AS mn, MAX(i.delivery_date) AS mx FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps ON i.playback_session_id = ps.playback_session_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `active_accounts`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber`
WHERE `account_status` = 'Active'

SELECT t.name, t.territory_id, COUNT(*) AS invoices, SUM(i.subtotal_amount - i.discount_amount) AS net_revenue_ex_tax, SUM(i.total_amount_due) AS billed_incl_tax, SUM(i.amount_paid) AS collected, SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_status = 'Paid' THEN i.subtotal_amount - i.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_rev_paid FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = i.subscriber_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = s.territory_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Japan%' AND i.invoice_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.name, t.territory_id LIMIT 1001

SELECT
  try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `total_watch_time_hours`,
  COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `playback_sessions`,
  AVG(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`) AS `average_watch_time_per_session_seconds`,
  AVG(`playback_session`.`completion_percentage`) AS `completion_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-05-01 00:00:00')
  AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-10 00:00:00')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.playback_session_id) AS sessions, SUM(i.viewable_impressions) AS viewable FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p ON i.playback_session_id = p.playback_session_id WHERE p.platform_type = 'Tablet' AND i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers_partner_bundle`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`acquisition_channel` = 'Partner bundle'

SELECT g.name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS pct FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON i.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.series AS s ON e.content_series_id = s.series_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.genre AS g ON s.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY impressions DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.territory_id, t.name, w.window_type, w.availability_status, w.active_flag, w.blackout_flag, (w.window_open_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND (w.window_close_date IS NULL OR w.window_close_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE))) AS in_dates, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT w.title_id) AS titles FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = w.territory_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%German%' OR t.iso_alpha_2_code = 'DE' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT blackout_flag THEN title_id END) AS streamable, COUNT(DISTINCT title_id) AS incl_blackout FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE territory_id = 12 AND window_type = 'SVOD' AND active_flag AND availability_status = 'Active' LIMIT 1001

WITH ordered_switches AS (
  SELECT
    s.subscription_id AS old_subscription_id,
    s.subscriber_id,
    s.activation_date,
    s.termination_date,
    s.subscription_plan_id AS old_plan_id,
    LEAD(s.subscription_id) OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.subscriber_id
      ORDER BY s.activation_date, s.subscription_id
    ) AS new_subscription_id,
    LEAD(s.activation_date) OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.subscriber_id
      ORDER BY s.activation_date, s.subscription_id
    ) AS new_activation_date,
    LEAD(s.subscription_plan_id) OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.subscriber_id
      ORDER BY s.activation_date, s.subscription_id
    ) AS new_plan_id
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s
  WHERE s.subscription_status = 'Superseded'
    AND s.termination_date IS NOT NULL
    AND s.activation_date IS NOT NULL
), paid_switches AS (
  SELECT
    os.old_subscription_id,
    os.new_subscription_id,
    CASE
      WHEN old_plan.contract_term_months IS NOT NULL AND old_plan.contract_term_months > 1
        THEN try_divide(old_plan.base_price, old_plan.contract_term_months)
      ELSE old_plan.base_price
    END AS old_monthly_price,
    CASE
      WHEN new_plan.contract_term_months IS NOT NULL AND new_plan.contract_term_months > 1
        THEN try_divide(new_plan.base_price, new_plan.contract_term_months)
      ELSE new_plan.base_price
    END AS new_monthly_price
  FROM ordered_switches AS os
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS old_plan
    ON os.old_plan_id = old_plan.subscription_plan_id
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS new_plan
    ON os.new_plan_id = new_plan.subscription_plan_id
  WHERE os.new_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
    AND os.new_activation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND os.new_activation_date = os.termination_date
    AND old_plan.plan_type = 'Paid'
    AND new_plan.plan_type = 'Paid'
)
SELECT try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN paid_switches.new_monthly_price < paid_switches.old_monthly_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS downgrade_share_percent
FROM paid_switches

WITH `reason_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` AS `churn_reason`,
    COUNT(*) AS `churn_count`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-10 00:00:00'
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-10 00:00:00'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
    AND `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `territory`.`territory_group`,
    `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description`
), `ranked_reasons` AS (
  SELECT
    `region`,
    `churn_reason`,
    `churn_count`,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY `region`
      ORDER BY `churn_count` DESC, `churn_reason` ASC
    ) AS `reason_rank`
  FROM `reason_counts`
)
SELECT
  `region`,
  `churn_reason`,
  `churn_count`
FROM `ranked_reasons`
WHERE `reason_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `region`, `churn_reason`;

WITH `monthly_cash` AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice`.`invoice_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`invoice`.`amount_paid`) AS `cash_collected`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `invoice`
  WHERE `invoice`.`invoice_date` >= DATE'2026-08-01'
    AND `invoice`.`invoice_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
    AND `invoice`.`invoice_date` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice`.`invoice_date`)
)
SELECT
  AVG(`cash_collected`) AS `three_month_average_cash_collected`
FROM `monthly_cash`

WITH monthly_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`amount`) AS `monthly_processed_refund_amount`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
  WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'
    AND `processing_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `processing_date` >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10')
    AND `processing_date` < ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10'), 12)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`)
), running_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `monthly_processed_refund_amount`,
    SUM(`monthly_processed_refund_amount`) OVER (ORDER BY `month` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `running_processed_refund_amount`
  FROM monthly_refunds
)
SELECT
  `month`,
  `monthly_processed_refund_amount`,
  `running_processed_refund_amount`
FROM running_refunds
WHERE `running_processed_refund_amount` > 100000
ORDER BY `month`
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `mega_fan_members_today`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` = 'Mega Fan'

SELECT (SELECT SUM(cpm_realized) / 1000 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS delivered_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS impressions, (SELECT MIN(delivery_date) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS first_date, (SELECT MAX(delivery_date) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS last_date, (SELECT SUM(total_contracted_value) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order) AS contracted, (SELECT SUM(net_order_value) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order) AS net_contracted LIMIT 1001

SELECT SUM(`amount`) AS `total_refunded_amount`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'

SELECT COUNT(`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions_with_subtitles`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL

SELECT try_divide(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01 00:00:00')
  AND `session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-01 00:00:00')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT subscription.subscriber_id) AS paying_subscribers
FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS subscription
JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS subscription_plan
  ON subscription.subscription_plan_id = subscription_plan.subscription_plan_id
WHERE subscription.subscription_status = 'Active'
  AND subscription_plan.plan_type = 'Paid'
  AND subscription.activation_date <= DATE'2026-10-31'
  AND (subscription.termination_date IS NULL OR subscription.termination_date >= DATE'2026-10-01')

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement AS a JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = a.primary_license_holder_id WHERE a.windowing_strategy = 'Simulcast' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, s.statement_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.net_royalty_amount) AS net, s.currency_code FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement AS s ON s.holder_id = h.holder_id WHERE h.rights_holder_name LIKE '%Ashen%' GROUP BY ALL LIMIT 1001

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, s.statement_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.net_royalty_amount) AS net FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = s.holder_id WHERE h.rights_holder_name ILIKE '%Ashen Lantern%' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 3 LIMIT 1001

WITH `studio_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `series`.`production_company` AS `studio`,
    COUNT(*) AS `series_count`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `series`.`finale_date` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `still_airing_series_count`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
  WHERE `series`.`production_company` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `series`.`production_company`
), `ranked_studios` AS (
  SELECT
    `studio`,
    `series_count`,
    `still_airing_series_count`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `series_count` DESC) AS `studio_rank`
  FROM `studio_counts`
)
SELECT
  `studio`,
  `series_count`,
  `still_airing_series_count`
FROM `ranked_studios`
WHERE `studio_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `series_count` DESC, `studio` ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active' AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid' THEN `subscription`.`subscriber_id` END) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
